# Website pack, daily build and share: plan (2026-10-13)

The user asked for, in order:
1. A link preview card and icons.
2. Faster loading (one cached bundle).
3. Installable app (PWA).
4. "Copy result" on victory.
5. A daily build.

Base spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-06-clawd-vs-bugs-design.md`. The input and device model is in `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-more-ways-to-play-design.md`. The live site is https://clawd-2d.vercel.app (Vercel, built by `node tools/build-site.mjs` into `public/`).

## Global rules

- Vanilla JS with zero dependencies, also in `tools/` (Node built-ins only, such as `node:zlib` and `node:crypto`). Game scripts are IIFEs on `window.CB`.
- No `Math.random` in `src/core` or `src/game`. No `Date.now` in `src/game` (the lint test). `new Date()` is allowed outside `src/game`.
- Keep every existing behaviour and test. Keyboard and mouse text stays byte-identical except where this plan adds something. Non-daily runs must simulate bit-identically: the bot golden fingerprints in `tests/aimassist.test.js` must not change.
- `npm test` (`node --test`; never `node --test tests/`) must be green before you report.
- The dev `index.html` keeps loading the 49+ separate scripts. Only `public/` gets the bundle.
- `.gitignore` ignores `*.png` except `assets/**/*.png`, so committed images live in `assets/`.

## Contracts

### Assets (W1 makes them, W2 ships them)

All are generated by `tools/make-art.mjs` (`npm run art`) and committed. Generation is deterministic: the same bytes every run.

| File | Size | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `assets/og.png` | 1200×630 | Link preview: drawn at 240×126 and scaled ×5 with nearest-neighbour. Dark `src`-palette arena, the "CLAWD vs BUGS" logo in the bitmap font, Clawd large, a few bugs and sparks, the tagline "a pixel boss rush · play in your browser" and `clawd-2d.vercel.app`. |
| `assets/icon-192.png`, `assets/icon-512.png` | 192, 512 | App icon: Clawd on the dark background, filling about 70%. |
| `assets/icon-maskable-512.png` | 512 | Same, with Clawd inside the central 60% safe zone and a full-bleed background. |
| `assets/apple-touch-icon.png` | 180 | Same as the app icon, opaque. |
| `assets/favicon-32.png` | 32 | Clawd's face, crisp. |

`manifest.webmanifest` sits at the repo root:

```json
{
  "name": "Clawd vs Bugs",
  "short_name": "Clawd vs Bugs",
  "description": "…",
  "start_url": "/",
  "scope": "/",
  "display": "fullscreen",
  "orientation": "landscape",
  "background_color": "#0B0B10",
  "theme_color": "#0B0B10",
  "icons": "…the four app icons, with the maskable one marked purpose 'maskable'…"
}
```

`index.html` `<head>` additions (W1):

- `description`
- `canonical` https://clawd-2d.vercel.app/
- Open Graph: `og:type`, `og:site_name`, `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image` (absolute https://clawd-2d.vercel.app/assets/og.png), `og:image:width`, `og:image:height`, `og:image:alt`
- `twitter:card` `summary_large_image` with title, description and image
- `<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="assets/favicon-32.png">`, replacing `data:,`
- `<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="assets/apple-touch-icon.png">`
- `<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest">`

### Site build (W2)

`tools/build-site.mjs` `buildSite()` writes `public/`:

- **`public/game.<hash>.js`:** every script `index.html` lists, concatenated in order, each preceded by a `// ---- <path> ----` line. `<hash>` is the first 10 hex characters of the content's sha256.
  - Also write `game.<hash>.js.map`, a v3 line-level identity source map over the original files, and end the bundle with `//# sourceMappingURL=`.
- **`public/index.html`:** the dev `index.html` with its script tags replaced by one `<script src="game.<hash>.js"></script>`, followed by a small inline service-worker registration. It registers `/sw.js` only when `'serviceWorker' in navigator` and `location.protocol === 'https:'`, inside try/catch. Everything else is byte-identical.
- **`public/sw.js`:**
  - Precaches `/`, the bundle, `manifest.webmanifest` and every `assets/` file except `og.png`.
  - The cache name includes the hash.
  - Activate deletes old caches.
  - Navigations are network-first with a cached fallback, so a new deploy always shows. Everything else is cache-first.
- **Copies:** `manifest.webmanifest` and `assets/**` when present.
- **Returns:** `{ files, scripts, bundle }`.

`vercel.json` keeps the existing config and headers, and adds:

| Path | Cache-Control |
|---|---|
| `/game.(.*).js` and its map | `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` |
| `/assets/(.*)` | `public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800` |
| `/sw.js` | `no-cache` |

It also sets `/manifest.webmanifest` to `Content-Type: application/manifest+json`.

### Daily build (W3a)

`src/core/daily.js` (the file exists as a stub and is already listed in `index.html`):

```js
CB.Daily = {
  dateKey(date) -> 'YYYY-MM-DD',   // UTC
  today() -> dateKey(new Date()),
  seedFor(key) -> uint32 != 0,     // FNV-1a 32 of 'clawd-daily:' + key
  patchFor(key) -> patch id,       // today's starting patch: deterministic pick from CB.Patches.ORDER by seedFor(key)
  record(key, { time, deaths, yolo }) -> void, // guarded localStorage 'cb.daily'; keeps the best (fewest deaths, then fastest) per date
  result(key) -> null | { time, deaths, yolo },
};
```

- **`createRun({ daily: key, … })`:** sets `run.daily = key` (string), else `null`.
- **Patch offers on a daily run:** they come from a dedicated rng, `CB.createRng(mix(run.seed, stageIndex))`, so every player gets the same offers that day whatever happened in the fight. Non-daily runs are unchanged (bit-identical).
- **Title:**
  - A `[ daily build ]` button, always available (not behind the modes unlock). With the modes unlocked, the row holds rush, daily and yolo. It reads `[ daily build ✓ ]` when today's daily has been cleared.
  - Starting it calls `start({ daily: key, seed: seedFor(key), patches: { [patchFor(key)]: 1 }, yolo: this.yolo })`. Pad **B** starts it (B no longer cycles hats on the title). Touch and mouse tap or click it. Pad mode labels name their buttons, as rush and yolo do (`B: daily build`).

### Share (W3b)

`src/core/share.js` (stub, already listed):

```js
CB.Share = {
  URL: 'https://clawd-2d.vercel.app',
  text(run) -> string,
  // nav.share on touch when available ('shared'; an AbortError means 'cancelled'),
  // else nav.clipboard.writeText, else a hidden-textarea execCommand('copy'); 'failed' if all fail. Never throws.
  send(text, env = { nav, doc, device }) -> Promise<'shared' | 'copied' | 'cancelled' | 'failed'>,
};
```

`text(run)` is plain text with emoji allowed (it goes to the clipboard, not the bitmap font). For example:

```
Clawd vs Bugs: ALL TESTS PASSING ✓
⏱ 08:42 · 💀 3 deaths · 🐛 214 bugs squashed
🔧 Spread Shot, Rapid Fire ×2
📅 Daily build 2026-10-13 · --yolo        (only the parts that apply: daily, boss rush, --yolo)
https://clawd-2d.vercel.app
```

- **`input.withActivation(fn)`:** when a touch pointer is down, `fn` runs at the next touch pointerup (clipboard and share need a user activation, and a touch pointerdown is not one). Otherwise it runs now, because keydown and mousedown already granted transient activation.
- **Victory screen:**
  - A share button with its hit box exported as `CB.Screens.victory.SHARE_BOX`.
  - Labels come from new Prompts keys: `share` is kbm `[ copy result ] (C)`, touch `[ share result ]`, pad `[ X: copy result ]`. `shareDone` and `shareFail` are used for toasts.
  - It shows `daily build YYYY-MM-DD` when `run.daily` is set.
- **Play scene, on victory after the prompt delay:** KeyC, pad X, or a tap or click inside `SHARE_BOX` calls `input.withActivation(() => CB.Share.send(...).then(toast))` and does not leave. Any other confirm still plays again.
- **Daily result:** when a daily run reaches victory, the play scene calls `CB.Daily.record(run.daily, { time, deaths, yolo })` once.

## Tasks (file ownership; each in its own worktree, then cherry-picked onto main)

| Task | Owns |
|---|---|
| W1 Art + head | `tools/make-art.mjs`; `assets/*` (generated); `manifest.webmanifest`; `index.html` `<head>` only; `tools/serve.mjs` (content types for `.webmanifest`); `package.json` (`"art"` script); `tests/art.test.js` (new); `tests/build.test.js` (only if the artifact build needs it) |
| W2 Bundle + PWA | `tools/build-site.mjs`; `vercel.json`; `tests/site.test.js` |
| W3a Daily | `src/core/daily.js`; `src/game/stageRunner.js`; `src/scenes/title.js`; `tests/daily.test.js` (new); `tests/draw.title.test.js`, `tests/menus.devices.test.js`, `tests/stageRunner.test.js` (only to extend or adjust for the new button) |
| W3b Share | `src/core/share.js`; `src/core/input.js` (`withActivation` only); `src/core/prompts.js` (new keys); `src/scenes/victory.js`; `src/scenes/play.js` (the victory branch only); `tests/share.test.js` (new); `tests/prompts.test.js`; `tests/draw.screens.test.js`; `tests/play.devices.test.js`; `tests/input.devices.test.js` (only to extend) |

W3b codes against the `CB.Daily` and `run.daily` contract with guarded lookups, and stubs them in its tests.
